lead: A single region that opens and closes: one trigger button plus a panel, for a lone "show more" or "advanced options". For a group where only one opens at a time, use [Accordion](/accordion).

usage.title: Usage
usage.text: Only the people you invite can see this project. You can change the visibility at any time from the project settings.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.text: Retry count, timeout and proxy settings live here.

no-icon.title: Custom trigger
no-icon.description: `icon={false}` removes the arrow; `render` swaps in your own element.
no-icon.text: Build #482 finished in 2m 14s on the main branch.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.trigger: The trigger button and its arrow; the button has `data-panel-open` when open and `data-disabled` when disabled
styling.panel: The panel and the content box inside it; the height animation uses `--collapsible-panel-height` with `data-starting-style` / `data-ending-style`
